lines: Thahar thori der to, ai jaan-e-maikhana, zara
couplets.en: Stay a little longer, O heart of the tavern.

lines: Thahar thori der to, ai jaan-e-maikhana, zara

couplets.en: Stay a little longer, heart of the tavern, and let me too drink a cup or two.

lines: Yeh teri zulf-e-pareshan bhi sanwarunga abhi

couplets.en: If I ever come to my senses again, let them call me a heretic.
